title: tanacetum aromaticum
intro: Tanacetum aromaticum, commonly known as Tansy, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family that is native to Europe, Asia, and North Africa. The health benefits of Tanacetum aromaticum include its use as a natural antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Tansy include its ability to act as a spasmolytic, reducing muscle spasms and promoting relaxation, as well as its use as a nervine, helping to calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Tanacetum aromaticum include sesquiterpene lactones, such as thapsigargin, and volatile oils, such as borneol and thymol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
